About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The role

HEX brings together creative talent, emerging technology and industry-leading partners to turn innovation into scalable solutions for our clients.

We're looking for a Programme Director to lead the end-to-end delivery of a complex, high-profile programme at the intersection of creative production, AI and emerging technology.

You will translate strategic objectives into an integrated delivery plan, bring multiple workstreams together and ensure the programme delivers against its commitments. You'll take ownership of programme governance, dependencies, risks and decisions, providing the clarity and control needed to navigate complexity and maintain momentum.

Working across senior leadership, technology partners, clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams, you'll connect the bigger picture with the detail of execution, ensuring everyone is aligned on what needs to happen, when and why.

What you'll do

Lead the programme

  • Own the integrated programme plan, translating objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, deliverables and success measures.
  • Establish effective governance, clear accountability and a consistent approach to programme reporting and decision-making.
  • Maintain oversight of the critical path, dependencies and delivery commitments, ensuring activity across workstreams comes together to achieve the overall programme objectives.
  • Provide a clear view of programme health, progress and emerging issues, giving leadership the information needed to make timely, informed decisions.

Drive delivery

  • Lead delivery across multiple workstreams, aligning teams on priorities, milestones and interdependencies.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve blockers and drive action on issues before they impact delivery.
  • Manage changes to scope, timelines and deliverables, assessing their implications and ensuring trade-offs are agreed and understood.
  • Challenge assumptions, address competing priorities and keep teams focused on the outcomes that matter most.
  • Hold workstream leads accountable for commitments, following through on actions and intervening where delivery is at risk.

 

Align clients and stakeholders

  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across WPP, technology partners and client organisations.
  • Create alignment across teams with different priorities, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and a shared understanding of programme objectives.
  • Lead programme reviews and executive reporting, communicating progress, risks, decisions and required actions with clarity.
  • Act as the central point of coordination for programme delivery, connecting stakeholders and ensuring commitments translate into action.

Deliver measurable outcomes

  • Maintain oversight of performance against programme objectives, milestones, budgets and agreed commercial commitments, working with the relevant commercial and finance leads.
  • Define and track success measures that demonstrate client adoption, business impact and value delivered.
  • Identify emerging delivery or commercial risks, making their implications visible and driving appropriate action.
  • Use performance data and programme insight to inform decisions, address underperformance and improve outcomes throughout the programme lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, interdependent deliverables and senior stakeholders.
  • A proven track record of translating strategic objectives into executable plans and delivering against challenging commitments.
  • Strong programme management expertise across integrated planning, governance, critical path management, risk, dependencies and change control.
  • The judgement to anticipate problems, navigate ambiguity and make effective decisions when priorities or delivery conditions change.
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and hold teams accountable across matrixed organisations.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including an understanding of budgets, forecasts and performance against agreed commitments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear decisions, recommendations and executive-level reporting.
  • A proactive, collaborative approach, combining attention to detail with a clear focus on overall programme objectives.

Experience in creative production, digital transformation, AI-enabled programmes or technology partnerships would be advantageous.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

About the Team

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

 

What You Will Do

  • Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
  • Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
  • Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
  • Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
  • Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
  • Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

 

What You Must Have

  • Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
  • Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
  • Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
  • Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
  • Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
  • Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

 

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Event Streaming Systems
description:
Our Global Structure

Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and merchants every day. From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's (& Doordash's) growth at scale.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Event Streaming Systems team. This is a hybrid role.

In this role, you'll provide technical leadership for the event streaming infrastructure that powers business-critical workflows across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. You'll help define the long-term direction of our messaging and streaming platforms, lead high-impact technical initiatives across teams, and raise the reliability, scalability and operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Event Streaming Systems team within the broader Storage organisation. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.

  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.

title: Senior Director, Controls & Automation
description:
Senior Director – Controls & Automation, EMEA

Role Summary

We are looking for an accomplished Controls & Automation leader to shape the design, standardisation and delivery of Building Management Systems (BMS) across STACK’s EMEA Data Centre portfolio. As our regional technical authority, you will establish scalable, repeatable controls solutions while ensuring they meet the demands of complex, mission-critical projects.

This is a high-impact role combining regional strategy with practical engineering leadership. You will influence technical decisions from concept and detailed design through construction, commissioning, Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and operational handover, working alongside delivery teams, contractors and customers. You will also lead a small regional specialist team and support multiple projects across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

· Act as STACK’s EMEA technical authority for BMS, controls and automation, challenging designs and advising project teams, customers and delivery partners.

· Own the development and continuous improvement of a standardised, scalable EMEA BMS product, including regional specifications, control philosophies and engineering standards.

· Define repeatable system architectures, sequences of operation, hardware and software, networks, communications, graphics, alarms and equipment interfaces, with appropriate resilience and cybersecurity.

· Adapt standards to local regulations and customer requirements, driving reliability, maintainability, innovation, delivery efficiency and cost optimisation.

· Provide end-to-end technical oversight across multiple Data Centre projects, from concept and detailed design through construction, integration, commissioning, IST and operational handover.

· Review and approve controls designs, drawings, technical submissions and specifications; ensure effective integration with mechanical, electrical and other critical infrastructure.

· Oversee consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers; identify and mitigate design, programme, integration and commissioning risks, supporting customer acceptance and Ready for Service (RFS).

· Establish commissioning procedures and acceptance criteria; oversee Level 3, 4 and 5 testing where applicable, including functional scripts and failure scenarios under normal and abnormal conditions.

· Provide hands-on troubleshooting, root cause analysis and technical support for complex controls and communications issues, including chilled water systems, chillers, pumps, valves and free cooling.

· Capture lessons learned and improve future designs, standards and operational performance.

· Lead and develop a small regional specialist team, balancing resources and priorities across projects and supporting recruitment and succession planning.

· Work closely with engineering, construction, commissioning, operations, commercial and global technical teams; build supplier relationships and report risks and technical performance to senior leaders.

What You’ll Bring

· Extensive experience in controls engineering, BMS or industrial automation, with a strong hands-on background in programming, integration, engineering or commissioning.

· Significant delivery experience in hyperscale Data Centre's or comparable mission-critical environments, from design through construction, commissioning, IST and handover.

· Experience establishing technical standards, control philosophies and repeatable engineering solutions, alongside the judgement to balance strategy with practical delivery.

· Deep technical expertise in BMS, PLCs, DDC controllers, SCADA, controls logic, sequences of operation and system integration.

· Strong knowledge of Data Centre mechanical and electrical systems, particularly chilled water plant, chiller sequencing, pump controls and free cooling.

· Knowledge of BMS architecture, networks, resilience, cybersecurity, BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA and relevant communications protocols.

· Experience with functional testing, failure scenario validation, alarm management, trending and operational performance optimisation; familiarity with ASHRAE, EN 50600, IEC and applicable local standards.

· Proven ability to lead specialist teams and contractors across locations, solve complex technical problems and influence senior stakeholders with sound commercial judgement.

· A degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Controls, Automation, Mechatronics or a related field, or substantial equivalent practical experience. Professional accreditation or relevant certifications are advantageous.

What We Offer

· The opportunity to shape engineering standards and controls delivery across a growing portfolio of critical Data Centre infrastructure.

· A chance to build your career with STACK, working alongside experienced technical and delivery teams across EMEA.

· Competitive benefits aligned with local country policies.

About STACK Infrastructure

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world’s most innovative companies, designing, developing, and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty, and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.

For more information about STACK, please visit: www.stackinfra.com

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is

small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd

help write them from the first line, with ownership and a direct line to the founders.

Youʼll help make sure laboratory teams have the consumables they need, when they need

them. Youʼll have a say in the software they use to manage stock, and learn to use AI to make

everyday purchasing and inventory work easier.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building

once you've spoken with the team.

The role

This is a hands-on, early-career role within our Infrastructure team. Youʼll manage day-to-day

consumables purchasing, receive deliveries and keep stock records accurate, with training

and guidance from your manager and laboratory colleagues. As you learn the work, youʼll

organise your day independently and follow issues through to resolution.

Youʼll work with laboratory teams to understand demand, place orders within agreed budgets

and approvals, and chase delays before they disrupt work. Youʼll maintain supplier prices and

lead times, flag supply risks and get laboratory approval for any proposed substitutions.

At goods receipt, youʼll check orders against deliveries, including quantities, condition and

relevant batch, expiry and temperature requirements. Youʼll record receipts promptly, route

goods to the right storage and resolve discrepancies. Youʼll help physically set up storage

areas, organise stock into defined bin locations and label and barcode those locations so they

match the inventory records. Youʼll record stock movements and investigate differences

found during stock counts.

With guidance, youʼll propose reorder points and buffer stock using consumption, lead times

and planned activity. Youʼll track expiry dates, prioritise the earliest-expiring stock where

appropriate and maintain consistent item codes, units and pack conversions. Youʼll document

procedures, follow safety and quality requirements, and segregate items awaiting review.

Regular updates on supply risks and stock accuracy, together with reliable receipt records,

will help colleagues in the lab and finance.

Youʼll work directly with software engineers to shape the inventory tools you use every day.

Youʼll bring ideas from the lab, explain what needs to work differently and test new features

against real tasks. Your input will help decide what gets improved, with your manager and the

software team leading priorities, design and development. Youʼll also learn to use AI-assisted

workflows for tasks such as reviewing inventory data and preparing routine updates, then

help refine those workflows as you find better ways to work. Training and support will be part

of the role.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Learn the consumables, storage requirements and approval processes with laboratory

colleagues. Take on routine ordering and goods receipt with support.

◆ Check stock records against physical inventory and map the journey from purchase

request to use. Agree a practical storage layout and bin-location scheme with laboratory

colleagues, taking account of access and storage requirements.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Run routine ordering, receipts and stock counts independently within agreed processes.

Keep colleagues informed of shortages, overdue orders and expiring stock.

◆ Physically set up and organise the agreed storage areas, label and barcode bin

locations, and link them to inventory records. Propose replenishment settings with your

manager and laboratory colleagues, and document how stock is stored and moved. Turn

recurring problems into examples for the software team.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Check that colleagues can find, receive and return stock using the labelled and

barcoded locations. Resolve gaps in the layout or records, and refine replenishment to

reduce avoidable shortages and waste.

◆ Test available inventory features against everyday tasks and help colleagues adopt

improvements. With support, try an AI-assisted workflow for a routine task, check its

outputs and suggest how to improve it.

Who you are

Youʼre proactive, organised and attentive to detail, and you enjoy practical work where

accurate records have visible consequences. When a problem arises, you flag it promptly and

investigate practical solutions while keeping colleagues informed. You act within agreed

processes, bring options when a decision needs support and follow the issue through to

resolution.

Your experience may come from inventory, purchasing, logistics or laboratory operations,

including an apprenticeship or placement. A scientific degree and coding experience are not

required. We welcome transferable experience with physical stock and time-sensitive

supplies.

Youʼre willing to help beyond a fixed task list as the team grows, while using judgement about

when to escalate. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it

and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ Practical experience of inventory, purchasing, goods receipt, logistics or laboratory

operations.

◆ Careful record-keeping and an organised approach to checking deliveries, prioritising

work and following actions through.

◆ Confidence with digital tools and a willingness to learn to use AI, check its outputs and

improve recurring workflows over time. Prior AI expertise is not required.

◆ Clear communication with suppliers and colleagues, including explaining an operational

problem to a software developer.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Experience with laboratory consumables or expiry-sensitive and temperature-controlled

stock.

◆ Familiarity with inventory or ERP systems, barcode-based stock control, or testing new

software.

Why this is unusual

Alongside keeping supplies moving, youʼll help shape the software and AI-assisted workflows

that make the job easier. Youʼll work with engineers to turn a stock discrepancy or awkward

receiving step into a better tool, then see whether it works in practice. Youʼll build experience

in improving systems as well as running the day-to-day operation.

Youʼll have support as you learn, and room to contribute ideas from the start. Some people

find that mix energising; others prefer a more settled routine. It is worth knowing which suits

you.

How we work

This role is primarily on-site in Kingʼs Cross, London, typically four to five days a week,

because deliveries and physical inventory need someone there. The wider team is

distributed, so we write things down and keep colleagues informed.

We start the week with an all-hands and share written updates. We give feedback directly

and expect good ideas to be challenged on their merits, whoever proposes them.

UK benefits include 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10%

employer contribution after a three-month deferment, and Bupa private health cover.

The team you will join

Youʼll join the Infrastructure team and work closely with laboratory colleagues, software

engineers and finance. Your manager will help set priorities and support decisions on

inventory planning and wider process changes. Youʼll bring the day-to-day operational view

into those discussions.

Our process

We start with a short screening conversation, followed by a behavioural interview. Weʼll ask

for examples of how youʼve spotted a problem, kept others informed and taken practical

steps to solve it, including when you sought support. Next comes a role-specific work sample

and a discussion of how you approached it, followed by references. Weʼll explain the

assessment format in advance, and youʼll meet us in person before any offer.

If the role interests you, apply through the person who introduced you or the recruiter who

shared it. If youʼre unsure whether you meet every requirement, we still want to hear from

you.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the

strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome

from candidates of any background.

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

This is not a research role. Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

  • Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

  • Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

  • Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

  • Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

  • Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.

About You

  • You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

  • You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

  • You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

  • You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

  • You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

  • You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Senior backend engineer to own the pricing system for all apps at Photoroom. You'll help deliver Product Growth initiatives and pricing architecture while collaborating closely with other engineers (both frontend and backend) and product owners.

Compensation: 95k to 105k + Stock-Options/BSPCE

Location: Paris (hybrid)

About the Role

  • You will own your work from A to Z: it goes from working on the architecture & coding features to monitoring releases' performance (we use Datadog for monitoring).

  • You will own the delivery and the architecture of the pricing system used by all our products (iOS, Android, Web, API) and millions of users.

  • You will get fast feedback from our users and will iterate quickly (we update the backend multiple times a week). You will follow the usage of the product and make decisions based on that.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, front-end) to actively help design and deliver seamless user experiences.

  • You will optimise existing endpoints, driving down latency and ensuring we can continue to scale to ever greater usages

About You

  • You have 5+ years of experience in backend development with Django and Django Rest Framework

  • You have experience working with a relational database at scale, designing schemas, optimising Django queries, and running migrations with minimal downtime

  • You have experience with scaling SaaS and subscription management (Stripe, RevenueCat)

  • You have a hands-on experience with a PostgreSQL/MySQL database larger than 100 GB

  • You have experience designing endpoints in direct collaboration with frontend engineers, delivering both Open API and developer manuals/supporting documentation

  • You are always the most pragmatic person in the room. You favour speed of iteration over perfect, always leverage frameworks and libraries to avoid reinventing the wheel

  • You have a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative and you are at ease to make product & technical decisions.

  • You are fluent in English (French is not required!).

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Benefits

  • Office in Paris (Hybrid, from the 9th)

  • Regular team gatherings including in-person onboarding, yearly company offsite, and team retreats

  • Competitive equity package with stock options/BSPCE

  • €1,000 annual L&D budget

  • Private health insurance

  • Access to personalised mental health support via MokaCare

  • Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

  • Relocation support (up to €10k) for roles based in France

Hiring Process

  1. Screening call with Talent Manager (30min)

  2. Technical interview with Hiring Manager (45min)

  3. Take-home assignment (duration varies by role) and live review with the team (45min)

  4. Culture fit interviews and meet the team (~3h in total)

  5. Reference check and offer

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Senior Product Manager, SMB e-commerce Growth
description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, SMB E-commerce Growth to own activation, monetization, and retention for our SMB e-commerce segment across the Photoroom mobile and web apps. This is a growth role: you'll own the levers that turn sign-ups into retained subscribers, and the growth-led features that move them. From paywalls to pricing experiments and onboarding and discovery flows, you'll partner closely with User Acquisition on the handoff from paid to product, and with the core SMB product team on what gets built next.

Location: Paris, we offer relocation support (Hybrid

About the role

  • Own a real slice of the growth funnel. Activation, paywall, pricing, or retention: you'll lead a squad and own a specific number end-to-end, deciding what gets tested, what gets built, and what gets killed.

  • Move the metric, not just the backlog. Run a high-velocity experimentation program across web and mobile funnels. Ship A/B tests weekly, and bigger feature bets when the data calls for them.

  • Find the insight, then build the feature. The best growth work is spotting why users drop off and shipping the change that fixes it. You'll do both.

  • Work across web and mobile. Mobile and web funnels behave differently (App Store vs. card-on-file, push vs. email). You'll own both, and partner closely with the User Acquisition team on the handoff from paid to product.

  • Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

  • You've moved real numbers on a subscription product. Five to eight years as a PM, with concrete activation, monetization, or retention wins you can name with the KPI, the change, and the percentage impact, owned by you, not by a team you sat on.

  • You've worked on something with recurring revenue. Whether B2B SaaS, B2C subscription, or B2B2C, as long as your work was tied directly to revenue your experience will give you a leg up. Pure marketplace or pure free-product backgrounds will struggle here.

  • You know how SMB sellers buy. You understand how SMB e-commerce sellers discover, evaluate, and adopt utility SaaS, the kind of motion behind Shopify, Canva, Klaviyo, Stripe, Klarna, Gorgias, Recharge, Loop, Wix, or Squarespace.

  • You think in funnels. You understand activation curves, paywall psychology, trial design, and the difference between credit-based, feature-gated, and seat-based pricing, and you have opinions on which works where.

  • You build with AI. You use Claude or equivalent to automate recurring tasks, and can explain how you set it up to help you ship faster.

  • You're data-fluent. Comfortable with SQL and an analytics platform like Amplitude or Mixpanel; you build and interpret your own funnel without waiting for a data scientist, and you've shipped a high volume of A/B tests personally in the last 12 months.

  • You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Nice to have: experience on both web and mobile funnels; familiarity with the Shopify ecosystem (app store, connect flows, merchant personas) or a comparable e-commerce platform; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic & AI Platform
description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the AI platform every Photoroom product is built on. Our mission is that any team ships best-in-class GenAI visuals without needing a backend engineer: the primitives, the gateway and the no-code tooling turn adding an AI capability into a configuration step rather than an engineering project. On top of that sits the agentic layer — multi-step visual workflows that generate, check, reason, route and publish on their own. Working closely with engineers, ML researchers, and the product teams who ship on your platform, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships.

Location: Paris, (Hybrid)

About the role

  • Own the platform every AI feature runs through. Expand and improve our AI gateway, including safeguards, evals, cost and observability, giving teams the ability to ship with little to no code and build skills that we can ship directly to users.

  • Build the agentic layer and Photoroom’s MCP. Visual agents that run multi-step flows: generate, QA, route, retry, publish, all unattended and at catalog scale.

  • Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the problem, then partner with engineering and research to ship work that feels effortless — for the developers and PMs using the platform as much as for end users.

  • Treat other teams as your customers. Every team's roadmap contains AI features gated on platform work. You'll prioritise across them, hold a strategy rather than a request queue, and say no with reasons.

  • Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue, and turn them into primitives other teams can reuse.

  • Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, such as adoption, latency, inference cost per successful generation, eval results. Form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

  • You've shipped products users love. 10+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you have solved a user’s problem and delivered business outcomes.

  • You've built platform, infrastructure or developer-facing products. APIs, SDKs, internal platforms, ML infrastructure — products whose users are engineers.

  • You've shipped something agentic or model-backed into production. You understand evals, guardrails, non-deterministic output, cost per call, and what breaks when a multi-step flow runs unattended a million times.

  • AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

  • You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now. On a platform, taste shows up in the interface you make other people build against.

  • You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

  • You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

  • You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Benefits

  • Competitive equity package with stock options/BSPCE, giving you ownership in our growing company

  • €1000 one-time home office grant OR €400 per month co-working space stipend

  • €1,000 annual learning and development budget for training, courses, books, and skill development

Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for positions based in France.

title: Ingénieur.e de recherche : Analyse de la chaine d'epuration de syngaz (H/F) - CDD 18 mois
description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.

GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.

Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.

Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.

Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont :

·       La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.

·       Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.

·       L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.

·       Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.

·       L’identification de critères permettant de guider les choix de construction d’une chaîne d’opérations.

·       La participation aux réunions de suivi du projet et la rédaction des comptes-rendus de réunion.

·       La rédaction de rapports du projet en français et des publications scientifiques en anglais et la création de supports de présentation.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Ce poste nécessite des compétences en génie des procédés, procédés thermiques, thermodynamique et modélisation de procédés. Le candidat doit avoir une expérience dans la modélisation 0D des procédés. La connaissance et la pratique d’un ou plusieurs logiciels de simulation de procédés libres ou commerciaux sera considéré un plus.

 

Le candidat doit faire preuve rigueur, être doté d’un bon sens de l’analyse et savoir travailler en autonomie au sein d’une équipe. Les qualités d’analyse bibliographique et rédactionnelles sont un point essentiel pour ce poste.

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

·       Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

·       cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

·       49 jours de congés par an

·       restauration administrative sur place

·       aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

·       action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

  • Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 18 mois

  • À usage interne :

Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche

  • Localisation du poste : IMT Mines Albi

  • Date limite de candidature : 26/11/2026

  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/01/2027

  • La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d'emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l'Institut Mines Télécom

title: Facility Maintenance Engineer H/F
description:
📍 IDF |Data Center | CDI | Astreinte 1 semaine sur 4

Rejoignez un environnement technique critique en pleine croissance

Mon client accompagne ses clients dans l'hébergement et l'exploitation d'infrastructures critiques au cœur de l'économie numérique.

Dans le cadre du développement de son site en pleine croissance et amené à s'étendre régulièrement, mon client renforce son équipe Facility et recherche un(e) Facility Maintenance Engineer.

Création de poste, vous rejoindrez une équipe Facility à taille humaine et aurez un rôle central dans le pilotage technique des infrastructures et des prestataires, avec une véritable responsabilité sur la qualité des opérations et la continuité de service.

Vous n'êtes pas nécessairement celui ou celle qui intervient directement sur les équipements : votre valeur réside dans votre capacité à comprendre les installations, analyser les problématiques, identifier les interactions entre les différents systèmes et challenger les prestataires sur leurs interventions.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) au Responsable de site, vous intervenez sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et assurez leur maintien en conditions opérationnelles.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment les infrastructures :

  • électriques HT/BT et leurs systèmes de secours ;
  • climatiques / CVC ;
  • protection incendie ;
  • infrastructures techniques associées.

Vous devez être capable d'appréhender l'ensemble du système et les interactions entre les différentes infrastructures, afin d'anticiper les impacts d'une intervention ou d'un incident sur la continuité de service.

Vos principales missions

1- Piloter la maintenance et les prestataires

Votre rôle principal consiste à assurer le pilotage technique des contrats et des prestataires de maintenance.

À ce titre, vous :

  • pilotez les contrats de maintenance et suivez les engagements associés ;
  • coordonnez et challengez les prestataires techniques ;
  • préparez et animez les réunions de suivi, notamment les réunions hebdomadaires;
  • contrôlez la qualité des interventions et leur conformité aux procédures ;
  • analysez les modes opératoires proposés par les prestataires et êtes capable de les challenger lorsque nécessaire ;
  • suivez les KPI techniques et les indicateurs de performance ;
  • veillez au respect du planning de maintenance et des exigences opérationnelles.

Vous êtes un(e) interlocuteur(rice) technique capable de faire le lien entre les besoins du site et les entreprises intervenantes.

2- Analyser les incidents et les problématiques techniques

L'analyse est une dimension essentielle du poste.

Lorsqu'une problématique survient, vous êtes capable de :

  • comprendre la situation dans sa globalité ;
  • analyser les causes et les interactions entre les différentes infrastructures ;
  • évaluer les impacts potentiels sur le fonctionnement du Data Center ;
  • orienter le prestataire vers les actions adaptées ;
  • challenger une analyse ou un mode opératoire lorsque celui-ci n'est pas suffisamment robuste ;
  • suivre les actions correctives jusqu'à leur résolution ;
  • contribuer aux retours d'expérience et à l'amélioration des pratiques.

Vous devez donc être capable de prendre du recul sur une problématique technique et de raisonner en système, plutôt que de vous limiter à un équipement isolé.

3- Accompagner le développement du site

Le site connaît une forte croissance, avec de nouveaux bâtiments amenés à être développés régulièrement.

Dans ce contexte, vous participez notamment à :

  • l'intégration des nouvelles infrastructures ;
  • l'identification et le suivi des problématiques techniques ;
  • la coordination des différents interlocuteurs ;
  • l'accompagnement des projets et des évolutions du site ;
  • l'amélioration continue des installations et des méthodes d'exploitation.

Votre rôle sera notamment de fluidifier les interfaces et de faire émerger les sujets nécessitant une action ou un arbitrage.

4- Travailler en transverse

Vous évoluez dans un environnement où les interactions sont nombreuses.

Vous travaillerez notamment avec :

  • le Responsable de site ;
  • l'équipe Facility ;
  • les prestataires de maintenance ;
  • les équipes projets ;
  • les fonctions transverses ;
  • les équipes en charge de l'ISO et de l'énergie ;
  • les équipes intervenant dans les audits, visites et relations clients.

5 - La capacité à travailler en équipe et à partager un objectif commun est donc essentielle.

Vous contribuerez également au suivi des sujets liés à la performance énergétique, aux exigences ISO et aux différents audits du site.

L'environnement de travail

Vous rejoindrez une équipe Facility actuellement composée de 3 personnes, au sein d'une organisation à taille humaine et soudée.

Il s'agit d'une création de poste, destinée à accompagner la croissance du site et à renforcer les ressources dédiées au pilotage technique.

L'environnement est dynamique : certains process sont encore en cours de structuration, notamment autour de la gestion des incidents.

Nous recherchons donc une personne capable de s'appuyer sur les procédures existantes tout en sachant évoluer dans des situations qui ne sont pas toujours parfaitement définies, avec pragmatisme et discernement.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez impérativement d'une expérience dans :

  • un environnement critique ;
  • les infrastructures techniques ;
  • la maintenance industrielle.

Vous possédez un bagage technique suffisamment large pour comprendre les environnements électriques, climatiques/CVC et de protection incendie, ainsi que les systèmes de secours associés.

Vous n'avez pas nécessairement vocation à intervenir directement sur les équipements : vous êtes avant tout capable de comprendre techniquement les installations et de piloter ceux qui interviennent dessus.

Les qualités recherchées

Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons une personne :

  • méthodique, capable de structurer son analyse et son action ;
  • dotée d'un fort esprit d'analyse, notamment face à des problématiques complexes ;
  • avec un véritable esprit d'équipe ;
  • capable de challenger des prestataires avec diplomatie mais fermeté ;
  • à l'aise dans un environnement où les situations peuvent parfois manquer de cadre ;
  • capable de prendre du recul et de comprendre les interactions entre les différents systèmes.
  • capacité à exploiter les outils de supervision, de reporting, de suivi énergétique et les données techniques pour détecter les dérives et optimiser la performance.
  • capacité à rédiger, challenger les procédures SOP MOP EOP et les valider à son niveau de périmètre

Votre capacité à analyser une situation, comprendre ses impacts et faire passer le bon message au bon interlocuteur sera déterminante dans votre réussite.

Avantages

Bonus /an : 2 mois de salaire si atteint

Indemnité astreinte : 505€ / semaine d'astreinte (fréquence 1S/mois environ) + paiement des heures supplémentaires en cas d'intervention

Indemnité forfait déplacement / an : 2512€

Indemnité télétravail / an : 175€

Participation : 1 mois et demi de salaire (voire plus)

Cadre

Astreinte

Ce poste comprend une astreinte dédiée au site à raison d'une semaine sur quatre.

Dans ce cadre, vous pourrez être sollicité(e) en soirée, le week-end ou en dehors des horaires habituels afin de contribuer à la continuité de fonctionnement du Data Center.

Pourquoi rejoindre ce poste ?

description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.

Sous l’autorité du Chef du service des ressources humaines, l’Analyste de données RH est chargé(e) de concevoir, produire et valoriser les données relatives à la gestion des ressources humaines afin d’éclairer la prise de décision, d’appuyer la planification stratégique des effectifs et de contribuer à la modernisation de la fonction RH.

 

Plus spécifiquement, il/elle est chargé(e) de :

  • collecter, consolider, fiabiliser et analyser l’ensemble des données RH notamment les données relatives aux effectifs, aux recrutements, à la mobilité, à la formation, à l’évaluation de la performance, à l’absentéisme, à la masse salariale, etc. ;

  • produire des analyses statistiques, des études prospectives et des rapports périodiques sur les ressources humaines ;

  • développer des outils de suivi permettant d’anticiper les besoins en effectifs, en compétences et en développement des talents;

  • assurer le contrôle de la qualité, de la cohérence et de l’intégrité des données RH ;

  • contribuer à l’élaboration et au suivi des indicateurs de performance de la fonction RH ;

  • garantir la confidentialité et la sécurisation des données conformément aux règles applicables au sein de l’Organisation ;

  • participer à l’administration fonctionnelle des outils et systèmes d’information RH ;

  • contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de collecte, d’exploitation et de restitution des données RH ;

  • accompagner le déploiement de nouveaux outils numériques et de solutions décisionnelles en matière de gestion des ressources humaines ;

  • assurer l’assistance fonctionnelle aux utilisateurs pour les questions liées aux données RH et aux outils de reporting ;

  • contribuer à l’automatisation des rapports et des processus de traitement des données ;

  • fournir aux responsables RH et aux gestionnaires des analyses permettant d’éclairer les décisions relatives aux effectifs, aux compétences et à la gestion des talents ;

  • contribuer à la préparation des rapports institutionnels et des documents destinés aux organes de gouvernance ;

  • participer aux projets de transformation et de modernisation de la fonction RH ;

  • réaliser toute autre tâche confiée par le Chef du SRH selon les besoins du service.


Le/La candidat(e) au poste devra :

  • être ressortissant(e) d’un État ou gouvernement membre de l’OIF ;

  • être titulaire d’un diplôme universitaire de niveau Master au minimum en statistiques, économie, mathématiques appliquées, informatique décisionnelle, gestion des ressources humaines, gestion des données ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent ;

  • justifier d’une expérience professionnelle d’au moins trois (3) ans dans l’analyse de données, l’intelligence décisionnelle ou la gestion de données RH ;

  • avoir une bonne connaissance des indicateurs et processus de gestion des ressources humaines ;

  • maîtriser les outils d’analyse et de visualisation de données (Power BI, Tableau, Excel avancé ou équivalent, VBA) ;

  • maîtriser les techniques statistiques ainsi que les méthodes d’analyse quantitative ;

  • avoir une expérience des systèmes d’information RH (SIRH) et des bases de données ;

  • posséder de solides capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de présentation des résultats ;

  • avoir une excellente maîtrise de la langue française, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit ;

  • faire preuve de rigueur, de sens de l’organisation et d’une grande attention à la qualité des données ;

  • être en mesure de travailler dans un environnement multiculturel et de respecter les exigences de confidentialité ;

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance
  • Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows
  • Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles
  • Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope
  • Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data
  • Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

    • Your Profile
  • PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or
  • Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience
  • Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time
  • Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation
  • Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim
  • Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques
  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++
  • Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack
  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery
  • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Bonus Points
  • Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation
  • Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems
  • Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments
  • Interest in agentic engineering toolchains
  • Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices
  • A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

title: KVGM Medewerker
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een centrale rol binnen KOERS waarbij kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu bovenaan staan? Dat komt dan mooi uit! Wij zijn op zoek naar een KVGM Medewerker die onze organisatie komt versterken. Solliciteer snel op deze vacature, want jij maakt voor ons het verschil!

Welke uitdagingen krijg jij als KVGM Medewerker?

Als KVGM Medewerker ondersteun je onze organisatie bij het ontwikkelen, uitvoeren en verbeteren van het beleid op gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu. Jij zorgt ervoor dat al onze collega’s hun werk veilig kunnen uitvoeren en draagt bij aan een gezonde werkomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en het management om de kwaliteit, arbeidsomstandigheden en het milieu te optimaliseren.

Welke uitdagingen horen onder andere bij deze functie?

  • Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van werkplekinspecties en veiligheidsrondes. Je bent regelmatig te vinden op onze verschillende bouwlocaties;

  • Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen en verbetermogelijkheden en bespreekt dit met de KVGM-coördinator;

  • Deelnemen aan en ondersteunen bij verschillende interne en externe audits;

  • Registeren en onderzoeken van incidenten, ongevallen en bijna-ongevallen;

  • Onderhouden en verbeteren van het KVGM-managementsysteem;

  • Het opstellen van een veiligheidsplan;

  • Het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving zowel op kantoor als op onze diverse bouwplaatsen;

  • Zorgdragen voor draagvlak binnen KOERS van veiligheidsbewustzijn;

  • Het uitvoeren en up to date houden van de RI&E;

  • Het verzorgen van veiligheidsinstructies, toolboxen en voorlichting;

  • Het regelen van keuringen van gereedschap en materieel.

Je standplaats is Barendrecht (Rotterdam), maar bent ook regelmatig op onze diverse projectlocaties (omgeving Randstand) te vinden. Je werkt nauw samen met de KVGM-coördinator en draagt bij aan periodieke rapportage aan onze Directeur Bouw.

Wat verwachten wij van jou als KVGM Medewerker?

Betrokkenheid, zelfstandigheid, een scherp oog voor veiligheid & kwaliteit en daarnaast plezier in je vak! Maak je werk uitdagender door op zoek te gaan naar nieuwe ideeën en werk daarin samen met je collega’s binnen KOERS. Is dit wat je zoekt? Dan hopen wij dat je over de volgende eigenschappen beschikt:

  • Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Je hebt HBO werk- en denkniveau, een opleiding in het vakgebied MVK genoten en ervaring binnen de bouwsector;

  • Kennis van de relevante wet- en regelgeving;

  • Kennis en ervaring omtrent ISO 9001, ISO 14001, VCA en SCL is een pré;

  • Je hebt oog voor risico’s en uitdagingen;

  • Je bent energiek, sociaal, ondernemend en daadkrachtig;

  • Je bent flexibel en bezit het vermogen om snel te kunnen schakelen;

  • Je staat sterk in je (werk)schoenen en hebt oog voor detail.

Wat bieden we jou?

Een verantwoordelijke functie waar je als KAM Medewerker bijdraagt aan het creëren van een gezonde werkomgeving. Daarnaast bieden we jou:

  • Een dienstverband van 32-40 uur per week;

  • Een goed salaris dat boven de normen van de cao Bouw en Infra ligt. We gaan hier graag over in gesprek met jouw achtergrond en ervaring als uitgangspunt;

  • Een auto van de zaak met tankpas volgens onze leaseregeling;

  • Een informele werksfeer en gezellige collega’s;

  • Goed geregelde vrije dagen, 30 vakantiedagen, 10 dagen in het tijdspaarfonds en nog 3 dagen kort verzuim. In totaal dus 43 vakantiedagen. Deze zaken zijn uiteraard conform de cao Bouw en Infra;

  • Een goed ingerichte werkplek;

  • Pensioenopbouw conform de richtlijnen van de CAO Bouw en Infra, dit bouwen wij samen op;

  • Een periodieke bijdrage aan je duurzame inzetbaarheid, zodat je gezond kunt blijven werken;

  • De mogelijkheid voor het volgen van opleidingen en/of cursussen, want jouw groei/ontwikkeling vinden wij belangrijk. Wij kijken graag samen met jou naar de mogelijkheden binnen ons opleidingsbudget.

Wil jij meebouwen aan de toekomst van KOERS?

Wacht dan niet langer en reageer gelijk op deze vacature!

title: HR Stagiair
description:
Ben jij een HR-student die niet alleen wil meekijken, maar echt wil meewerken? Bij Quatra krijg je geen stage met alleen opdrachten en meekijken vanaf de zijlijn. Je draait mee in het team, krijgt verantwoordelijkheid en leert hoe HR er in de praktijk aan toegaat.

Wat ga je doen

Als HR-stagiair bij Quatra werk je mee aan alles wat met mensen te maken heeft. Praktisch, operationeel en dichtbij de business. Je zit niet alleen achter je laptop, maar schakelt veel met collega’s en ziet direct wat jouw werk oplevert. Je komt terecht in een klein en betrokken HR-team. We werken informeel, helpen elkaar en zeggen waar het op staat. Geen hiërarchiegedoe, wel korte lijnen. Bij Quatra werken we volgens onze kernwaarden: Connect, Commit, Create. Dat merk je in hoe we samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen.


Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Ondersteunen bij werving en selectie, onboarding en offboarding;

  • Opstellen van arbeidsovereenkomsten en verwerken van personeelsmutaties;

  • Bijhouden van tijd-, verlof- en verzuimadministratie;

  • Meewerken aan lopende HR-projecten en verbeteringen in onze processen;

  • Uitvoeren van je stageopdrachten, afgestemd op jouw opleiding en leerdoelen.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Je volgt een HRM-opleiding (HBO of MBO) of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • Je bent enthousiast, gedreven en digitaal handig;

  • Je wilt leren door te doen en durft vragen te stellen;

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en neemt verantwoordelijkheid;

  • Je communiceert duidelijk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

  • Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar (stageduur ± 4 maanden).

Waarom stage lopen bij Quatra?

  • Een meewerkstage waarin je echt onderdeel bent van het team;

  • Veel verantwoordelijkheid en hands-on ervaring binnen een snelgroeiende en duurzame organisatie.

  • Een informele, directe en betrokken werksfeer waarin jouw ideeën welkom zijn.

Over Quatra:
Quatra is een internationale snelgroeiende groep, gespecialiseerd in het inzamelen en recyclen van gebruikte frituurolie. Geen marketingverhaal: duurzaamheid is hier het verdienmodel. We verwerken jaarlijks meer dan 250.000 ton UCO tot grondstof voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen, waaronder Sustainable Aviation Fuel, en opereren vanuit 10 landen met ruim 250.000 klanten in horeca, catering, industrie en scheepvaart. In Nederland bouwen we naast de klassieke inzamelactiviteiten aan een groeiende trading-operatie waarbij we wereldwijd volumes aankopen en via ons Europese netwerk vermarkten. Bij Quatra Nederland​ werken wij met ± 160 collega's.

Bekijk ook eens onze YouTube filmpjes op onze Quatra website.

Klaar om je HR-carrière te kickstarten?

Solliciteer direct! Heb je vragen? Neem contact op met Michelle (HR, Werving & Selectie) via 020 260 22 60.
